_description: Where the live TCSpy configuration is read from. config_dirs are tried in order and the first existing folder is used, so one file can serve several servers (add each server's mount path). config_overlay (optional) names a folder whose files take precedence over the live ones. The environment variables SEVENDT_CONFIG_DIR and SEVENDT_CONFIG_OVERLAY still override both. google_service_account_key: path of the Google service-account JSON used by the Observation request page (optional; GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS or TCSpy's googleSheet.config are tried too).
